native_paths.reset_domains: Peripheral/digital/cold cancel this device; CPU-only resets preserve RMT; circuit topology and charge are not reset by RMT
native_paths.dma: TX channel3/RX channel7 only, GDMA peripheral9, incremental actual symbol pumps and shared RX-idle EOF finalization; no precomputed RX data or whole-transfer DMA drain
native_paths.memory_ownership: RX HW/APB arbitration is checked; APB refill and wrapped cursors are driven by native threshold IRQs
native_paths.carrier: TX carrier high/low tick contract from LL; active-level envelope and always-on idle modulation, continuous same-level segment phase preserved
native_paths.sync: Selected TX channels arm until all selected channels started, then start at one modeled timestamp
native_paths.loop: Finite autostop and continuous cycles; zero-progress all-marker loops reject with ERR rather than timer livelock
